summary: The agent constructs an otherwise strong pipeline with sophisticated stacking, TF-IDF, and LightGBM. However, its primary flaw is significant data leakage from fitting feature extractors (TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD) and frequency encodings on the combined train and test dataset prior to cross-validation. Furthermore, it neglects the temporal nature of the data by using random cross-validation, risking look-ahead bias.
